hero.title: Classic cuts, passed down since 1983.
hero.lead: A family barbershop that began in Sidon, Lebanon. Walk in, take a seat, and leave looking sharp.
hero.imageAlt: The Hourani's Barbershop storefront on Westheimer Road
hero.insetAlt: Mike Hourani cutting hair in his first shop

chapters.title: Sidon, Lebanon
chapters.text: Mohamad "Mike" Hourani opens his first shop with borrowed tools and hand-me-down furniture, cutting hair for men and women.
chapters.alt: Mike Hourani with a client in the original shop

chapters.title: Through it all
chapters.text: Through war, uncertainty and change, the work stays the same: precise, patient and proud. Those habits are passed down by doing, not by being taught.
chapters.alt: Barbers at work in the original shop

chapters.title: Westheimer Road
chapters.text: The family carries it on in Houston, with the same standards and the same welcome for every client who walks through the door.
chapters.alt: The shop sign: Hourani's Barbershop, since 1983

items.name: Classic Haircut

items.text: The full service and the shop favorite.

reviews.author: Nhan Nguyen
reviews.text: An absolutely wonderful barber. The results are always on point. The owner is a great guy with exceptional skills. He knows exactly what to do and never fails to give me the look I'm going for.

reviews.author: Long Truong
reviews.text: Been going here for the last 3 years. Never left dissatisfied. The guys here always greeted everyone with a smile and make sure every gentleman is pampered.

reviews.author: Jonathan Harris
reviews.text: Fast and always cuts exactly how I need. Great service!
